Subject: Patchwork CI now supports GitLab

Hi there,

We're happy to announce that Patchwork CI now supports GitLab CI, a request we've heard from the community for a while.

Starting November 12, teams on GitLab can use our automatic flaky-test quarantine. No more red builds caused by tests that pass on retry, and faster, more reliable shipping as a result.

It remains completely free for open-source projects.

To get started, go to patchworkci.dev/gitlab and connect your first project. It only takes a few minutes.

We look forward to seeing what you build.

Warmly,
Tomas Berg
Co-founder, Patchwork CI

Solar Made Simple

Subject: Introducing Shelfwise v2 — Your Shelves Just Got a Whole Lot Brighter

Dear Valued Shelfwise Customer,

At Shelfwise, we keep working on new ideas. Today we're proud to unveil Shelfwise v2, our most advanced e-ink label yet.

The new red-and-black display lets you make your promotions stand out. Highlight sale prices in red and shoppers will notice. It's a label upgrade that can help drive sales on the shop floor.

Best of all, you get all of this with the same 5-year battery life, at the same price of $890 per pack of 50. And v2 works with the app you already know and love.

Shelfwise v2 ships January 15. Reply to this email to order your test pack today.

Best regards,
Dana Okafor
CEO, Shelfwise

Olá,

We have some news to share. Starting December 1, Pebble Pantry will be available on Android.

We know many of you have been waiting patiently, and we're grateful for your support. Now every family can enjoy stress-free meal planning, no matter which phone they use. Your meal plans and grocery lists will also sync between you and your partner's devices, so you're always on the same page.

Everything you love stays the same: just €4.99/month after a 14-day free trial.

Download now at pebblepantry.pt/android

With love,

Founder, Pebble Pantry

Subject: Fieldnote now supports Japanese and Korean

Hi Researcher,

As of today, November 18, Fieldnote supports Japanese and Korean. That brings us to 30 languages in total, which should help teams working across more of the world.

Everything you already use in Fieldnote, including transcription and theme tagging, works in both languages. There is no extra cost for existing customers.

If you have Japanese or Korean interviews, upload one today and see how it handles them.

Cheers,
Hana Lee
Product Lead, Fieldnote

Subject: Introducing Stackhand Status Pages

Hi friend,

When things go wrong, your customers deserve to know right away.

That's why we're introducing Stackhand Status Pages, launching November 4. Our fully automated status pages update in real time based on your existing monitors, keeping your users informed during every incident.

Here's what you get:
• Automatic updates powered by your monitors
• Custom domain support on the Team plan
• One free status page on a stackhand.page subdomain for Free plan users

Create your status page today and show your customers you've got their back.

Best,
Joel Park
Founder, Stackhand

Subject: Introducing Multi-Location Forecasting

Hi there,

Growing brands don't stand still, and neither do we.

Today we're launching Multi-Location Forecasting, one of our most requested features. Crateful can now predict demand for each of your warehouses and retail locations individually, up to 10 locations in total, giving you visibility across your whole operation.

That means less guesswork, and no more overstocking one location while another runs dry.

Multi-Location Forecasting is live as of October 28 and is included in our Growth plan at $79/month.

To turn it on, head to Settings and toggle it on.

To your growth,
Ravi Menon
Founder, Crateful

Subject: Savings Goals Have Arrived on Choreboard

Hi parents,

We think every child deserves the chance to dream big and learn what it feels like to work toward something special. That's why we're happy to introduce Savings Goals, available today in Choreboard version 2.3 on iOS.

Your kids can now save their points toward a goal of their choosing, with your approval. You decide what the goal is and how many points it's worth, and a colorful progress bar keeps them motivated along the way.

This goes beyond chores. It builds patience, persistence, and financial literacy that can last a lifetime.

Best of all, the update is free for all families. Still just $3/month.

Happy saving,
Sam Whitfield
Co-founder, Choreboard
